tasks.title: Scaffold company-standard app structure with enforced domain boundaries and four-deployable topology
tasks.description: SUPERSEDED LAYOUT - do NOT create app/Domains/*. The repository is already bootstrapped on the company architecture bible (docs/meadowkart_backend_architecture_bible_by_claude.md) section 1, which mandates responsibility-first top-level directories (Actions, Channels, Console, Constants, Contracts, DTOs, Enums, Events, Exceptions, Exports, Filters, Helpers, Http, Imports, Jobs, Listeners, Models, Notifications, Observers, Providers, Rules, Services, Support, Traits, Utils), each carrying {Domain}/ subdirectories. That layout is the company standard and stays. Express the eleven ADR-0008 / SN-ARCH-002 modules (Identity, Leads, Activity, Content, Sharing, Sequences, Automation, Acquisition, Messaging, Billing, Platform) as the {Domain}/ subdirectory axis inside each responsibility directory - i.e. the module name is the SECOND namespace segment (App\Models\Leads\Lead, App\Services\Leads\LeadService, App\Events\Leads\LeadAssigned), not the first. Create that subdirectory skeleton for all eleven modules under Models, Services, Actions, Contracts, DTOs, Enums, Events and Listeners. Add a static-analysis CI rule (Deptrac layers, or a custom PHPStan rule) that resolves a class's module from that second namespace segment and fails the build when one module's code imports another module's Eloquent model directly instead of going through a published domain event or an explicit public service interface in app/Contracts/{Domain}/ (SN-ARCH-002). NOTE the genuine tension this creates: bible section 4's own worked example has CartService importing the Product model across domains, which SN-ARCH-002 and ADR-0008 forbid. SN-ARCH-002 is the tiebreaker for this project - the CI rule is normative and the bible example is not to be copied. This must be captured in the deviation record (TASK-ARCH-036). Stand up the four deployable build targets from 09-technical-architecture.md section 1 SN-ARCH-003: API (Laravel Octane), Web app (Next.js authenticated SPA), Public surface (separate Next.js build, no auth, no CRM bundle), Workers (Laravel Horizon), as separate repo build/deploy configs - confirming the modular-monolith decision (SN-ARCH-001, no microservice extraction) is reflected in a single Laravel codebase with these four build outputs.
acceptance_criteria: No app/Domains directory exists anywhere in the repository; the bible section 1 top-level layout is intact
All eleven SN-ARCH-002 modules exist as {Domain}/ subdirectories under at least Models, Services, Contracts and Events
Running the CI static-analysis rule against a deliberately-introduced cross-module model import fails the build, with the module resolved from the second namespace segment
Four independent build/deploy pipelines exist and each produces its own artifact
The Public surface build has zero import edges into the Web app's bundle, verified by a CI import-graph check

tasks.title: Define core API envelope, error catalogue and OpenAPI/typed-client generation pipeline
tasks.description: Implement the response envelope conventions from 05-api-design.md section 2 (success envelope {success, data, meta, policy}, list envelope with meta.pagination/counts/applied_filters/sort, error envelope with {code, message, details, trace_id} on every error), the full HTTP status code table (section 4, including 404-for-cross-tenant, 423 Locked, 425 Too Early) and the permanent/additive error code catalogue (section 4.1). APPROVED DEVIATION from the company architecture bible (docs/meadowkart_backend_architecture_bible_by_claude.md) section 9, which specifies a bare {data} / {error:{message}} envelope and explicitly forbids a success boolean. 05-api-design.md declares itself normative and its policy object and error-code catalogue are load-bearing for permission and plan gating, so the spec envelope wins for this project. Record the deviation per the bible's closing line (see TASK-ARCH-036). Implement it by EXTENDING the bible's existing App\Traits\ApiResponse trait (bible section 8) rather than introducing a parallel response layer: keep responseData/responseSuccess/responseCreated/responseError as the only public surface, add list and policy support, and keep the bible's rule that controllers never call response()->json() directly. Validation errors keep Laravel's native 422 shape wrapped to match. Wire Laravel route/request/response definitions to generate an OpenAPI spec, and generate TypeScript types plus a typed API client from that spec (09-technical-architecture.md SN-ARCH-032). Add a CI step that fails when the committed OpenAPI spec differs from the freshly generated one, per SN-ARCH-032 - hand-written API types are forbidden. This is the foundational contract task that unblocks all other frontend work in this slice.
acceptance_criteria: Every API response in the app matches the success/list/error envelope shape in 05-api-design.md section 2
Response shaping happens only inside App\Traits\ApiResponse and API Resources; a CI grep finds zero response()->json() calls in controllers
CI fails a PR that hand-edits generated TypeScript types without regenerating from OpenAPI
A 500 error response includes trace_id and the same value appears in the server log entry
The bible section 9 deviation is recorded and approved before this task closes

tasks.title: Implement /bootstrap response contract
tasks.description: Define the request/response contract, validation and route for GET /api/v1/bootstrap exactly as specified in 05-api-design.md section 6: user, organization, membership, capabilities, subscription, app_constraints, feature_flags, navigation, warnings, onboarding, activation, counts, server_time. Include the X-Bootstrap-Stale: true invalidation header contract on mutating requests. This task only defines the contract/route/generated types (per ARCH-04's pipeline) - the actual payload assembly logic is a separate backend-logic task.
acceptance_criteria: GET /api/v1/bootstrap is present in the generated OpenAPI spec with every field in 05-api-design.md section 6
Frontend typed client exposes a Bootstrap type matching the documented shape

tasks.title: Define pagination, filtering/sorting query DSL and global search contract
tasks.description: Implement the two pagination modes (offset for leads/content/team, cursor with opaque base64 cursors for timeline/messages/events/activity) per 05-api-design.md section 7, the simple query-param filters (section 8.1), the POST /{resource}/query complex filter contract with max nesting depth 2 and max 20 conditions (section 8.2), and the GET /api/v1/search?q=&types=&limit= contract (section 8.3, 16). Validation must clamp per_page above 200 rather than reject, and report the clamp in meta. This contract defines the shape every list/search endpoint in the product must conform to.
acceptance_criteria: A request with per_page=500 is clamped to 200 and meta reports the clamp, not rejected with 422
A /query request with nesting depth 3 or 21 conditions returns 422 VALIDATION_FAILED
Cursor pagination never exposes a raw offset

tasks.title: Define Idempotency-Key and optimistic-concurrency middleware contract
tasks.description: Implement the Idempotency-Key header contract on all billable/user-visible-artefact-creating POSTs (05-api-design.md section 9): 24h key+response storage, replay returns original response with X-Idempotent-Replay: true, same key + different body returns 409 CONFLICT. Implement If-Match/ETag optimistic concurrency on PATCH: a mismatch returns 409 CONCURRENT_MODIFICATION with the current record. Document which endpoints require the header (lead create, message send, campaign send, share mint, payment, bulk operations) versus which are naturally idempotent (share minting, WhatsApp ingest).
acceptance_criteria: Replaying a POST with the same Idempotency-Key and identical body returns the original response with X-Idempotent-Replay: true
Same key with a different body returns 409 CONFLICT
A PATCH with a stale If-Match returns 409 CONCURRENT_MODIFICATION and includes the current record

tasks.title: Define bulk-operation preview/execute pattern and async job polling contract
tasks.description: Implement the generic bulk-operation contract from 05-api-design.md section 10: every bulk endpoint has a /preview sibling with an identical request body, selection.mode of IDS or FILTER, and a preview response of {affected_count, eligible_count, ineligible[], estimated_cost, warnings[], requires_confirmation}. Bulk operations over 500 records run async, returning 202 {job_id}, pollable at GET /api/v1/jobs/{job_id} returning {status, progress, processed, total, errors[], result_url}.
acceptance_criteria: Calling a bulk endpoint's /preview sibling never mutates data and returns the documented preview shape
A bulk operation over 500 records returns 202 with a job_id pollable at /jobs/{job_id}

tasks.title: Define relative-move ordering convention and presigned-upload contract
tasks.description: Implement the relative-move reordering contract (05-api-design.md section 11) used by sequence steps, rule priority, custom-field display order, form fields and page blocks: POST .../move {position: AFTER|UP|DOWN, relative_to} - never a full index array. Implement the presigned upload contract (section 12): POST /api/v1/uploads/sign {filename, mime, size_bytes, purpose} enforcing plan limits and MIME allowlists before any byte moves, returning a 15-minute-expiry signed URL; purpose enum is CONTENT_FILE|PAGE_IMAGE|AVATAR|LOGO|IMPORT_CSV|TIMELINE_ATTACHMENT|CAMPAIGN_MEDIA.
acceptance_criteria: A move request is a constant-size relative operation, never a full reordered array
An upload-sign request exceeding the plan's file_max_bytes or an disallowed MIME is rejected before a signed URL is issued

tasks.title: Implement read/write DB replica routing
tasks.description: Configure Laravel's database connection layer per 09-technical-architecture.md SN-ARCH-012: writes go to the primary; heavy reads (analytics, exports, rollups) are routed to a read replica; request-path reads (anything a rep is looking at live) stay on the primary to avoid showing stale/missing data under replication lag.
acceptance_criteria: An export or analytics rollup query executes against the replica connection
A request-path read (e.g. fetching a just-created lead) always executes against the primary connection

tasks.title: Implement tenant-scoped Redis caching layer
tasks.description: Implement the caching layers from 09-technical-architecture.md SN-ARCH-013: bootstrap payload per membership (5 min TTL, invalidated on mutation), plan constraints/feature flags/integration registry (1 h TTL), permission resolution per membership (5 min TTL, invalidated on change). Every cache key MUST include organization_id - a colliding key is a cross-tenant leak.
acceptance_criteria: Every cache key used by this layer is prefixed or namespaced with organization_id, verified by a test that asserts no key collision across two org fixtures
A permission change invalidates the cached permission resolution for that membership within the same request cycle

tasks.title: Implement /bootstrap payload assembly service
tasks.description: Implement the service that assembles the full /bootstrap payload defined in 05-api-design.md section 6, aggregating: user, organization, membership, capabilities, subscription, app_constraints, feature_flags, navigation (server-driven per plan/flag state), warnings (single channel for all banners - expiry, payment failure, WhatsApp health, seat limits), onboarding, activation, counts, and server_time. Cache per ARCH-12 and invalidate via the X-Bootstrap-Stale: true response header on relevant mutations.
acceptance_criteria: GET /bootstrap returns every field in 05-api-design.md section 6 with real (not stubbed) values once dependent domains exist
A mutation that changes navigation-relevant state (plan change, flag rollout) causes the next response to include X-Bootstrap-Stale: true

tasks.title: Implement SSE real-time channel infrastructure
tasks.description: Implement server-sent-events infrastructure per 09-technical-architecture.md SN-ARCH-014: one-way push for inbound messages, content-view alerts and lead-assignment notifications. Channels are scoped per membership and authorised on connect (reusing the permission resolution from the permissions system). This deliberately uses SSE, not WebSockets, because the need is one-way and SSE survives proxies/mobile networks and reconnects automatically. Also lay the groundwork referenced by the roadmap's G3 timeline gap-marker/conversation-rendering work (12-roadmap.md, SN-TL-026), which will build on this same channel.
acceptance_criteria: A membership only receives SSE events it is authorised to see, verified by a two-membership fixture test
A dropped SSE connection auto-reconnects without a full page reload

tasks.title: Implement PostgreSQL full-text and phone-normalised search service
tasks.description: Implement the backend search service per 09-technical-architecture.md SN-ARCH-015 and 05-api-design.md section 8.3: PostgreSQL full-text search with GIN indexes (no Elasticsearch in V1), returning grouped results with a type discriminator, p95 < 200ms. Phone-number search MUST be normalised through libphonenumber against the org's default country before hitting the index, tolerating spaces/dashes/brackets/with-or-without country code - this is the single most common search a rep performs.
acceptance_criteria: p95 search latency is under 200ms against a representative data volume

tasks.title: Migrate inbound_event ingestion log table
tasks.description: Write the migration and model for inbound_event per 04-domain-model.md section 8.4: id, organization_id (null), source_key, integration_connection_id (null), raw_payload jsonb, headers jsonb, signature_valid bool, received_at, processed_at, status (PENDING|PROCESSED|FAILED|DUPLICATE|REJECTED), error, lead_id (null), attempt_count. Every inbound webhook must be persisted here before any processing - this table is what lets support replay a webhook rather than guess when a parser breaks or a customer disputes a missing lead. Retention: 90 days.
acceptance_criteria: inbound_event has all columns and the five-value status enum from 04-domain-model.md section 8.4
A 90-day retention job purges rows older than the window

tasks.title: Implement generic webhook ingestion pipeline framework
tasks.description: Implement the reusable ingestion pipeline framework mandated in 05-api-design.md section 14 and 09-technical-architecture.md SN-ARCH-041: verify signature (reject unsigned/mismatched with 401, logged) -> persist to inbound_event (ARCH-16) before any processing -> return 200 immediately -> process asynchronously on the highest-priority ingest queue with its own supervisor -> deduplicate on the provider's event id (at-least-once delivery is guaranteed, not exactly-once) -> never trust payload shape (schema-validate; a shape change produces a FAILED row, not a 500 that loses the lead). This generic base class/middleware is what every concrete webhook handler (WhatsApp, Facebook Lead Ads, other integrations, billing) is built on top of in their own domain's implementation. Duplicate-lead detection on ingest (12-roadmap.md G2, SN-LEAD-060) runs as a hot-path step inside this same pipeline and must not block the 200-ack.
acceptance_criteria: A webhook request is acknowledged with 200 before any business processing completes, p95 ack time < 200ms
A replayed webhook with the same provider event id is silently discarded, not double-processed
A malformed payload produces a FAILED inbound_event row, never a 500

tasks.title: Implement outbound resilience framework
tasks.description: Implement the reusable outbound-call resilience components from 09-technical-architecture.md SN-ARCH-042: retry with exponential backoff and jitter, a circuit breaker per provider, timeouts on every external call (5s connect, 15s read), and a dead-letter queue that is actively monitored (alerted on), not merely populated. This is a shared library other domains' provider integrations (WhatsApp, payments, lead-source integrations) wrap their outbound calls with.
acceptance_criteria: An outbound call that times out is retried with backoff+jitter up to a configured max, then lands on the dead-letter queue
The circuit breaker opens after a configured failure threshold per provider and stops issuing calls until it half-opens
A dead-letter entry triggers an alert, verified in staging

tasks.title: Scaffold external provider port interfaces
tasks.description: Define the port (interface) contracts from 09-technical-architecture.md SN-ARCH-040 so no vendor SDK ever appears above its port and the provider is a config value, not an architectural commitment: WhatsAppChannelProvider, PaymentProvider, LeadSourceParser, NotificationChannel, StorageProvider, LlmProvider. Follow the company architecture bible (docs/meadowkart_backend_architecture_bible_by_claude.md) section 24 for placement and naming: interfaces live in app/Contracts/{Domain}/ and are named {Capability}Interface (WhatsAppChannelProviderInterface, PaymentProviderInterface, LeadSourceParserInterface, NotificationChannelInterface, StorageProviderInterface, LlmProviderInterface), keeping each contract small and focused. Bind implementations in a service provider using a config-driven match() expression exactly as shown in bible section 24, so switching provider is a config edit. This task creates the abstract interfaces and config-driven binding mechanism only; concrete implementations belong to their owning domains - WhatsAppChannelProvider is implemented against the Coexistence/BSP work described in the roadmap's G3 Wedge gate (contact-sync-as-reviewable-import SN-WA-023, phased history sync SN-WA-025), PaymentProvider against Razorpay/Stripe (G4), LeadSourceParser against each integration (G2).
acceptance_criteria: Each of the six ports exists in app/Contracts/{Domain}/ as a {Capability}Interface with no vendor SDK type in its signature
Bindings are resolved from config via a match() expression in a service provider, per bible section 24
Swapping a provider binding is a config change, verified by binding a stub implementation in tests with zero code changes to callers

tasks.title: Implement structured logging with PII redaction and distributed tracing
tasks.description: Implement JSON structured logging carrying trace_id, organization_id, membership_id, route and duration on every log line (09-technical-architecture.md SN-ARCH-050). PII (phone numbers, emails, message bodies, OTP codes) MUST be redacted at the logger level via a Monolog processor, not at each call site, so redaction cannot be forgotten by an individual developer (also required by 10-nfr-security-compliance.md SN-SEC-010). Use Sentry as the error-tracking sink - it is a required package in the company architecture bible (docs/meadowkart_backend_architecture_bible_by_claude.md) section 22 and is already installed (sentry/sentry-laravel in composer.json). Wire it through withExceptions()->reportable() in bootstrap/app.php per bible section 18, not a legacy app/Exceptions/Handler.php (which does not exist in Laravel 11+). Ensure the same PII redaction applies to Sentry payloads, not just local log lines. Implement OpenTelemetry distributed tracing across API, workers and outbound calls (SN-ARCH-051), with trace_id returned on every error response so a support ticket maps to a trace in one search; the trace_id surfaces through the error envelope defined in TASK-ARCH-004.
acceptance_criteria: A log line containing a phone number, email, message body or OTP code has the sensitive value redacted, verified against real log output
A Sentry event for the same exception carries the same redaction, verified against a captured payload
Every error response's trace_id resolves to exactly one trace spanning API + worker + outbound call legs
A captured push payload contains no lead name, phone number or message body

tasks.title: Build the app shell: route tree, navigation rail/tabs, global +New action
tasks.description: Implement the Next.js 16 App Router route tree and app shell per 03-information-architecture.md section 2-3: desktop persistent left rail (Leads/Inbox/Content/Automations/Sources/Insights, Team/Settings below the divider, org switcher), mobile bottom tab bar (Leads/Inbox/Follow-ups/Content/More, FAB), and the global context-aware +New action (New lead first, then message/file/page, sequence, import - never a menu deeper than one level). Badge counts on Leads/Inbox only, sourced from /bootstrap.counts and .navigation. Implement the responsive breakpoints from section 9 (sm/md/lg/xl), noting the spreadsheet grid is lg-and-above only and /leads/grid redirects to /leads/table below that. This is mostly client-rendered per 09-technical-architecture.md SN-ARCH-030; the public surface, signup and marketing routes are server-rendered separately (see ARCH-29).
acceptance_criteria: Navigation entries and their badges render exactly from bootstrap.navigation/.counts with no hardcoded nav item
On a viewport under 1024px, navigating to /leads/grid redirects to /leads/table
The +New action is reachable in exactly one tap/click on mobile and never opens a menu deeper than one level

tasks.title: Set up frontend state-management architecture and shared optimistic-mutation pattern
tasks.description: Establish the frontend state architecture per 09-technical-architecture.md SN-ARCH-031: TanStack Query for server state (caching, invalidation, retry), Zustand for small global client state (bootstrap payload, UI prefs, active org), React Hook Form + Zod for form state, and search-params-backed URL state for filters/sort/pagination. Implement the optimistic-update pattern from SN-ARCH-033 as a shared, reusable mutation hook/utility: a failed mutation rolls back and shows an inline retry on the specific element that failed - never a full-screen error for one failed cell. This shared utility is what every domain's list/detail screens (leads, follow-ups, timeline, inbox) build their optimistic interactions on top of, covering follow-up complete, stage change, group assign, inline field edit, message send, and mark-read actions alike (merged scope, see docs/08-ux-flows.md Cross-cutting rules > Optimistic UI).
acceptance_criteria: A mutation hook exists that performs an optimistic update and rolls back only the affected element on failure, with an inline retry affordance
Filter/sort state for a list is readable from and writable to the URL query string via a single shared hook
A simulated mutation failure on any of follow-up complete, stage change, group assign, inline field edit, message send, or mark-read reverts only the affected element, never a full-screen error

tasks.title: Implement offline resilience: service worker, queued writes and flaky-connection handling
tasks.description: Implement graceful offline degradation per 09-technical-architecture.md SN-ARCH-035: a service worker caches the app shell and recent reads; writes made while offline queue in IndexedDB and flush automatically on reconnect, with a visible pending state; a queued message MUST survive a page reload. This is explicitly not full offline mode (that is V2) - it targets the bad-connection reality of the ICP. Also implement the flaky-connection framework from docs/08-ux-flows.md Cross-cutting rules > Offline and flaky connections: reads served from cache show a staleness indicator, and a connectivity banner appears only after 5 continuous seconds of failure (not immediately, to avoid flapping on brief blips) so nothing is lost and nothing flickers.
acceptance_criteria: A write made with the network disabled is queued in IndexedDB, shows a visible pending indicator, and is sent automatically on reconnect
Reloading the page while a write is queued does not lose the queued write
A cached read shows a staleness indicator when served offline, and the connectivity banner appears only after 5 continuous seconds of failure

tasks.title: Build global search UI (Cmd+K / Ctrl+K)
tasks.description: Implement the global search field in the header per 03-information-architecture.md section 7: Cmd+K/Ctrl+K shortcut, results grouped and ordered leads -> content -> sequences -> team members, recent-items as a zero-query state. Must render first results within the 200ms p95 budget from the backend and must never reveal the existence of a lead the caller cannot view (permission-scoped results only).
acceptance_criteria: Pressing Cmd+K (or Ctrl+K) from anywhere in the app opens the search field
Results are grouped in the documented order and a zero-query state shows recent items
A user who lacks visibility into a lead never sees it appear in search results, even as a partial match

tasks.title: Build URL-state synchronisation utility for filters, sort and pagination
tasks.description: Implement the shared utility mandated in 03-information-architecture.md section 8 and referenced from 09-technical-architecture.md SN-ARCH-031 (SN-LEAD-082): filter/sort/pagination state MUST live in the query string so a filtered list is shareable and survives reload; list scroll/selection position SHOULD be preserved on back-navigation from a detail view; modals MUST NOT own a route unless deep-linking is a genuine requirement; destructive confirmations MUST NOT be routable; IDs in URLs MUST be opaque ULIDs, never sequential integers.
acceptance_criteria: Reloading a filtered list URL restores the exact same filters and sort
Navigating back from a detail view to a list restores prior scroll/selection position
A route containing a resource id rejects/404s a sequential-integer-looking id pattern in tests, confirming only opaque ids are used

tasks.title: Build lead detail screen layout scaffold
tasks.description: Implement the structural layout of the lead detail screen exactly as specified in 03-information-architecture.md section 5 - the single most-visited screen in the product: header with lead name and NEW LEAD badge, assignment/follow-up summary row, an always-above-the-fold ContactActionBar (WhatsApp/Call/Email/SMS + Send content/Add to sequence), a collapsible DETAILS panel, and a collapsible TIMELINE panel with an inline event stream (all event types - messages, content views, calls, logs - render as one unified stream, not separate tabs) and inline-editable custom fields (click value -> type -> blur to save, no modal). This task builds the layout scaffold, panel structure and above-the-fold guarantee; live data binding to the lead/timeline contract is out of scope here.
acceptance_criteria: On a 375px-wide viewport, the ContactActionBar is fully visible without scrolling
Timeline events of every type render in one chronological stream, not in separate tabs
Clicking a custom field value enters inline edit with no modal opened

tasks.title: Scaffold public recipient-facing surface deployment
tasks.description: Stand up the separate Next.js build for the public/recipient-facing surface per 03-information-architecture.md section 3.8 and 09-technical-architecture.md SN-ARCH-003: routes /t/:slug/:code (tracked content viewer), /f/:code (hosted lead form), /qr/:code (redirect), /u/:token (unsubscribe), served from a short branded domain per organisation falling back to the platform domain. This deployment MUST NOT load the application bundle, MUST NOT load any marketing/advertising tracker, and CI MUST enforce that it never imports from the CRM (Web app) bundle. It is server-rendered (per SN-ARCH-030) for first-paint and indexability.
acceptance_criteria: A CI import-graph check fails if any file under the public-surface build imports from the Web app bundle
No third-party script tag (analytics, pixel, session recorder) loads on any route under this deployment
The branded-domain routing falls back to the platform domain when an org has no share_domain configured

tasks.title: Integrate bootstrap-driven navigation, warnings and counts into the app shell end-to-end
tasks.description: Wire the real /bootstrap payload assembly service (ARCH-13) into the live app shell (ARCH-21), replacing any placeholder/mock navigation, badge counts or warnings banner. Confirm the single warnings channel renders every producer (expiry, payment failure, WhatsApp health, seat limits) through one shared banner component, and that a plan change or flag rollout reshapes navigation with no frontend release.
acceptance_criteria: Toggling a feature flag server-side changes the rendered navigation on next bootstrap fetch with no code deploy
A warning of each documented type (expiry, payment, WhatsApp health, seat limit) renders through the same banner component

tasks.title: Integrate SSE real-time channel into the frontend end-to-end
tasks.description: Wire the real SSE backend (ARCH-14) into the app shell/timeline UI (ARCH-21/ARCH-28), replacing any mock/poll-based updates: inbound-message, content-view and lead-assignment events must appear live without a manual refresh, and the connection must auto-reconnect after a network drop.
acceptance_criteria: A server-emitted lead-assignment event appears in the UI within 2 seconds without a page refresh
Killing the network for 10 seconds and restoring it results in automatic SSE reconnection and no missed-event gap larger than the outage

tasks.title: Integrate global search end-to-end
tasks.description: Wire the real backend search service (ARCH-15) into the Cmd+K search UI (ARCH-25), replacing any mock results, and confirm permission-scoping, phone-number tolerance and the p95 < 200ms budget hold under integration.
acceptance_criteria: A live search for a lead's phone number in loose/mixed formatting returns that lead
End-to-end search latency from keystroke to rendered results is under 200ms at p95 in a representative environment

tasks.title: QA: verify tenant isolation suite green in CI
tasks.description: Verify the G0 exit criterion from 12-roadmap.md section 2: a member of two organisations can log in, switch between them, and see a correctly-scoped empty state, with the tenant isolation suite (ARCH-10) green in CI. Run every list endpoint as two distinct tenant fixtures and assert zero row overlap; run the REP-vs-MANAGER visibility test class described in 06-permissions-and-plans.md section 1.6 confirming a REP sees strictly fewer rows than a MANAGER in the same fixture.
acceptance_criteria: The two-tenant zero-overlap suite passes for every list endpoint in CI
A REP fixture returns strictly fewer rows than a MANAGER fixture on every applicable list endpoint

tasks.title: QA: verify API contract conformance
tasks.description: Verify the API conventions defined in ARCH-04 through ARCH-09 hold in an integration environment: OpenAPI-vs-generated-client CI diff check fails on drift; idempotency replay and conflict behaviour is correct; bulk preview/execute parity holds (preview never mutates, execute matches the previewed outcome); pagination clamping is correct; ordering moves are conflict-free under concurrent reorder; presigned uploads reject over-limit/disallowed files before a byte moves.
acceptance_criteria: A contract test suite exercises every rule in 05-api-design.md section 2-12 and is green
CI blocks a merge that introduces OpenAPI/client drift

tasks.title: QA: verify IA cross-cutting states, responsive breakpoints and search performance
tasks.description: Verify the six-state UI primitives (D-04, formerly ARCH-26) are actually used (not a bespoke ad-hoc state) on every list/detail surface built so far, that the responsive breakpoint rules from 03-information-architecture.md section 9 hold (grid redirect below lg), and that the search p95 < 200ms budget (section 7) is met end-to-end (ARCH-32).
acceptance_criteria: A visual/accessibility audit confirms all six states render correctly on at least one representative list and one detail screen
Search p95 latency is verified under 200ms in a load test

tasks.title: QA: verify webhook ingestion pipeline resilience
tasks.description: Verify the generic ingestion pipeline (ARCH-17) against 09-technical-architecture.md SN-ARCH-041 and the metrics in SN-ARCH-052: signature verification correctly rejects unsigned/mismatched requests with 401 and logs them; webhook ack time is under 200ms p95; replayed events are deduplicated by provider event id; a malformed payload produces a FAILED, replayable row rather than a 500; dead-letter entries are monitored, not merely populated.
acceptance_criteria: An unsigned webhook request is rejected with 401 and produces a log entry
Replaying the same provider event id twice results in exactly one processed effect
Webhook ack p95 is under 200ms under load test

tasks.title: Record architecture-bible deviations and reconcile ADR-0008 with the shipped app structure
tasks.description: The company architecture bible (docs/meadowkart_backend_architecture_bible_by_claude.md) closes with "Deviations require explicit justification and team lead approval". This project takes three, and they need to be written down and approved rather than discovered later by whoever reads the bible and the code side by side. (1) API envelope: 05-api-design.md section 2's {success, data, meta, policy} / {success:false, error:{code, message, details, trace_id}} supersedes bible section 9's bare {data} / {error:{message}}, which explicitly forbids a success boolean. Justification: the dual policy object and the error-code catalogue are load-bearing for permission and plan gating, and 05-api-design.md is normative. See TASK-ARCH-004. tasks.title: Implement the 8-step permission resolution pipeline and visibleTo query scope
tasks.description: Implement the resolution order from 06-permissions-and-plans.md section 1.5 exactly, first-denial-wins: (1) authenticated? no->401, (2) membership.organization_id matches resource? no->404 (never 403 - avoids an enumeration oracle), (3) membership.status=ACTIVE? no->403 ACCOUNT_DEACTIVATED, (4) capability grid permits? no->403 INSUFFICIENT_ROLE, (5) record-level scope (assignment/sub-team/accessible_whatsapp_account_ids, fail-closed) permits? no->403 NOT_ASSIGNED, (6) plan includes feature? no->423 FEATURE_NOT_IN_PLAN, (7) within plan limits? no->423 PLAN_LIMIT_REACHED, (8) feature flag on? no->425 FEATURE_NOT_ENABLED. tasks.title: Configure Laravel Octane runtime and stateless-request review checklist
tasks.description: Deploy the API on Laravel Octane per 09-technical-architecture.md SN-ARCH-010 for persistent-worker throughput. Document and enforce via code review the consequence that application state persists between requests: static properties, singletons holding request data, and runtime-mutated container bindings are bugs. Add this as an explicit, named checklist item in the PR review template. SPECIFIC HAZARD to call out by name in the checklist: the company architecture bible (docs/meadowkart_backend_architecture_bible_by_claude.md) section 26 shows a ResolveTenantMiddleware that does app()->instance('tenant', $tenant). That is a runtime-mutated container binding and it leaks the previous request's tenant to the next request on the same Octane worker - a cross-tenant data leak, not a performance nit. Tenant and membership context MUST be request-scoped (resolved per request and passed explicitly, or reset in an Octane RequestReceived listener), and the tenant isolation suite (TASK-INFRA-001) MUST include a two-consecutive-requests-different-tenants case that runs under Octane.

tasks.title: Implement session issuance, rotation and multi-org switching

Implement org-picker listing for users with more than 1 active membership and an org-switch endpoint that swaps the active organisation context without a full re-authentication (SN-AUTH-007); the switch mints a new access token scoped to the newly-selected membership rather than mutating server-side state, so it stays correct under Octane.

tasks.title: Schema: content base + message/file/page detail tables, folders, labels, shared-folder grants

tasks.title: Contract: content CRUD, token/page-template schema endpoints, file signing, search/filter API

Implement MAIN/FOLLOW_UP/DEFAULT_SHARE role handling (SN-CONT-010), with DEFAULT_SHARE auto-filling the accompanying text when sharing a file/page, configurable per content type. Implement WhatsApp template authoring validation (SN-CONT-012): reject templates starting/ending with a variable, adjacent variables, non-sequential numbering, and component character limits - enforced at save time via the CONT-002 contracts 422 response. tasks.title: Backend logic: file upload/processing pipeline with S3 presign and five-state lifecycle
tasks.description: Implement direct-to-S3 presigned upload issuance that enforces the 100MB max size and 200-page PDF limit at the signing step, before any byte is uploaded (SN-CONT-021, AC-CONT-020.1). Implement the five-state async processing lifecycle (SN-CONT-020): NOT_PROCESSED to PROCESSING to PROCESSED, plus terminal WILL_NOT_PROCESS (valid file of a non-trackable type - distinct UI/retry path) and FAILED (real error, offers retry with a plain-language reason). The file appears in the list immediately in its current state and processing runs as a queued job so the user can navigate away and return (SN-CONT-022). Generate a rendered trackable derivative for supported types (PDF viewer, images) while retaining the original; store via opaque storage keys with CDN delivery (SN-CONT-023).

tasks.title: Backend logic: page block persistence, block-type registry, and per-page CTA resolution
tasks.description: Implement persistence and validation for the ordered blocks array (SN-CONT-032): uniform slot_key/type/value/style keying for every block type including image galleries (no bare images special case), semantic style tokens only (e.g. spacing:md style values, never raw CSS/Tailwind classes), and never round-tripping placeholder strings as persisted content. Implement the nine block types from SN-CONT-030 (TITLE, DESCRIPTION rich-text-constrained, GALLERY up to 20 images, VIDEO YouTube embed, MAP Google Maps location, LINK, ATTACHMENT, PDF_VIEWER, CTA: Call/WhatsApp/Email/URL). Enforce SN-CONT-034: no code path may inject Facebook Pixel/GTM or any third-party tracking script into page rendering.

A pages default_page_cta falls back to the org preference when no per-page override is set.

tasks.title: Backend logic: folders/labels taxonomy, search/filter, and engagement stats incl. TOTAL_UNOPENED

tasks.title: Backend logic: visibility promotion, copy-on-edit, archive/delete lifecycle, and shared-folder revocation
tasks.description: Implement the three-way visibility state machine PRIVATE to SUBTEAM to ORG (SN-CONT-003), gating promotion to ORG behind content.set_visibility_org and to SUBTEAM behind content.set_visibility_subteam. Implement copy-on-edit (SN-CONT-004): a member who can view but not edit shared content must be offered Make-a-copy, creating a PRIVATE duplicate owned by them. Implement the archive/delete state machine (SN-CONT-005): ACTIVE (shareable, existing links work, visible in list) vs ARCHIVED (not shareable, existing links keep working, visible on request) vs deleted (not shareable, existing links break, not visible) - these are three genuinely distinct states, not two. Implement deletion pre-check and blocking (SN-CONT-006, AC-CONT-006.1): the confirmation states how many tracked links will break, how many leads opened it, and how many sequences reference it; deletion is blocked with 409 naming the sequence(s) until they are updated, by querying sequence_steps for references to this content. tasks.title: Backend logic: public viewer rendering, owner exclusion, and revocation handling
tasks.description: Implement server-side rendering for the separate viewer deployment (SN-SHARE-010): minimal JS, fast on 3G, zero third-party analytics/advertising/session-recording scripts under any configuration (SN-SHARE-011). Render sender branding - logo, colours, name, photo, contact details, Powered-by-SalesNova unless white-label enabled (SN-SHARE-012). Resolve personalisation tokens (including the page title) at render time, not mint time (SN-SHARE-005). Handle revocation: a revoked link returns 410 Gone with a neutral no-longer-available page, never an error and never leaking what it used to be (SN-SHARE-006, AC-SHARE-006.1); deleting the source content invalidates every link minted from it. Implement owner-exclusion at render time - when the content owner or any org member opens the link, tracking scripts are omitted entirely from the rendered HTML, never filtered after the fact (SN-SHARE-040), detected by combining (1) an active CRM session on the same browser, (2) a signed viewer_context cookie set on the share domain when a logged-in member last minted/opened a link, and (3) an IP match against the orgs recent authenticated request IPs within 24h (SN-SHARE-041).
acceptance_criteria: AC-SHARE-006.1

tasks.title: Backend logic: engagement-gated, bot-filtered view/duration ingestion pipeline
tasks.description: Implement server-side enforcement of the engagement gate (SN-SHARE-030, AC-SHARE-030.1): a view is never recorded on page load alone - the ingest endpoint only registers a view once the client reports one of dwell-3s-visible, a scroll event, or an interaction event has fired. Implement bot/prefetch/scanner filtering on ingest (SN-SHARE-031, AC-SHARE-031.1): reject known bot/link-preview user agents, prefetch-purpose headers, per-share_code rate-limit violations, and known security-scanner ranges - log rejections with reason, never count them. Implement duration ingestion per SN-SHARE-032/034: accept keepalive fetch periodic delta reports and a final sendBeacon flush; each report carries only the delta since the last CONFIRMED report; the server MUST NOT accept/advance a clients watermark without confirming receipt, and a chunk without a valid view_id is buffered/rejected, never attributed (AC-SHARE-034.1). Floor all durations to whole seconds server-side, never round (SN-SHARE-035). Persist NULL when no duration data was received and 0 only when a genuine zero-duration bounce was measured - never conflate the two (SN-SHARE-036, AC-SHARE-036.1). Implement the 30-second server-side reload dedup window. Hash IPs before storage, never store raw (SN-SHARE-037).

tasks.title: Schema: sequences, steps, enrolments, and break-criteria configuration
tasks.description: Create migrations/models per F08 sections 2/4: sequences (type enum MANUAL|AUTOMATED|MIXED per SN-SEQ-002, visibility PRIVATE|SUBTEAM|ORG per SN-SEQ-013, status DRAFT|ACTIVE|PAUSED|ARCHIVED per SN-SEQ-053), sequence_steps (order integer for execution order including delay steps, display_number separate from order so delay steps render as 0 between numbered steps per SN-SEQ-010, delay_seconds, delay_display_unit, action enum SHARE_CONTENT|CONTACT_LEAD|DELAY|SEND_WHATSAPP_TEMPLATE, executor enum USER|SYSTEM per SN-SEQ-001, instructions free text for CONTACT_LEAD, content_id FK to CONT-001s content table for SHARE_CONTENT/SEND_WHATSAPP_TEMPLATE steps), sequence_enrolments (status incl. ACTIVE|COMPLETED|BROKEN|REMOVED, current_step, break_reason, unique constraint enforcing max 1 active enrolment per (sequence, lead) per SN-SEQ-012), and a break_criteria JSONB config column per SN-SEQ-020 (on_inbound_message, on_outbound_message, on_content_view, on_stage_change array, on_follow_up_completed) defaulting on_inbound_message true and terminal-stage breaks to ON. Enforce the 20-step max and served via app_constraints (SN-SEQ-012).
acceptance_criteria: A DB constraint (not just application code) prevents a second concurrently-active enrolment for the same (sequence, lead) pair.

tasks.title: Contract: sequence CRUD, relative step-move, enrolment, and /my-tasks endpoints
tasks.description: Define routes/requests/policies/generated types (SN-ARCH-032) for: sequence CRUD gated by sequences.manage capability; POST /api/v1/sequences/{id}/steps/{step_id}/move accepting position AFTER plus relative_to - never a full index array (SN-SEQ-050, per 05-api-design.md section 11); manual enrolment (gated only by lead access, SN-SEQ-013), bulk enrolment with a /preview endpoint (SN-SEQ-031); the /my-tasks task-queue endpoint (SN-SEQ-040); the live-edit-impact endpoint returning affected-enrolment counts and the apply-to-new-only vs apply-to-all choice (SN-SEQ-051); and the pre-activation preview endpoint rendering a sample-lead timeline with tokens resolved (SN-SEQ-052).
acceptance_criteria: The step-move endpoint accepts only relative position payloads; no endpoint accepts a full step-order array.

tasks.title: Backend logic: sequence builder domain rules - ordering, limits, visibility, permission split
tasks.description: Implement the order/display_number split so the builder reads step 1, wait 2 days, step 2 rather than step 1, step 2, step 3 (SN-SEQ-010), including delay_display_unit redisplay logic (e.g. 86400 seconds redisplays as 1 day). Enforce the max-20-steps limit and expose it via app_constraints (SN-SEQ-012). Implement the PRIVATE/SUBTEAM/ORG visibility model reused from content (SN-SEQ-013) and the permission split: creating/editing a sequence requires sequences.manage, enrolling a lead requires only lead access - deliberately different capabilities so managers design and reps run (SN-SEQ-013).
acceptance_criteria: A member with lead access but without sequences.manage can enrol a lead but cannot edit the sequence definition.

tasks.title: Backend logic: enrolment engine - manual/bulk/preview, re-enrolment, removal
tasks.description: Implement the four enrolment paths (SN-SEQ-030): MANUAL (from lead detail), BULK (from a list/filter), RULE (consumed by F09 automation actions), API (V1.5 stub). Implement bulk-enrolment preview (SN-SEQ-031) returning: how many leads are eligible, how many already enrolled, how many opted out, how many are in a terminal stage, and the estimated cost if any SYSTEM step sends templates. Implement explicit re-enrolment (SN-SEQ-032): a lead who completed a sequence may be re-enrolled only via explicit confirmation, recorded as a new enrolment - automatic re-enrolment triggered by a rule must never happen. Implement removal (SN-SEQ-033): sets status=REMOVED, cancels pending steps, writes a timeline event, while completed steps and their history remain. Enforce the max-1-active-enrolment-per-(sequence,lead) invariant at the application layer with a clear conflict error.
acceptance_criteria: A rule-triggered enrolment attempt against an already-completed lead is rejected automatically, never silently re-enrolling.

tasks.title: Backend logic: break-criteria engine
tasks.description: Implement break-criteria evaluation per SN-SEQ-020 against every active enrolment: on_inbound_message (defaults ON) triggered by an inbound WhatsApp message event, on_outbound_message (defaults OFF), on_content_view (defaults OFF, consumes the SHARE-006 view-event pipeline), on_stage_change array (list of stage names), on_follow_up_completed (defaults OFF). Implement terminal-stage default breaking (SN-SEQ-022): reaching a stage flagged is_terminal (F03 SN-FIELD-020) breaks every active enrolment for that lead. Implement unconditional opt-out breaking (SN-SEQ-023, AC-SEQ-023.1): a WhatsApp opt-out breaks every active enrolment for that lead within 60s regardless of configured criteria - this is not configurable. On break, write a SEQUENCE_BROKEN timeline event naming the reason (SN-SEQ-021), and support resuming from the same step or restarting.
acceptance_criteria: AC-SEQ-020.1
AC-SEQ-023.1

tasks.title: Backend logic: USER-step task queue - /my-tasks, complete/skip/snooze
tasks.description: Implement /my-tasks generation (SN-SEQ-040): USER-executor steps land as tasks in the reps queue, grouped by due date mirroring the follow-up buckets, each showing the lead, step, instructions, and a one-tap action payload (open WhatsApp with the message pre-filled, using the SHARE-003 minting mechanism for SHARE_CONTENT steps, or share content directly). Keep /my-tasks and /follow-ups as separate but cross-linked surfaces - a sequence task represents organisational process, not personal judgement. Implement completion semantics (SN-SEQ-041): Complete (records what was sent, advances the enrolment), Skip (advances with a required reason - always available so a rep is never blocked by an inapplicable step), Snooze (delays the step only, not the whole sequence).
acceptance_criteria: Skipping a step never requires a reason from a fixed enum only - free-text reason is accepted.
A SHARE_CONTENT tasks one-tap action mints/reuses the same idempotent share link as the manual share flow.

tasks.title: Backend logic: SYSTEM-step dispatcher with dispatch-time precondition re-verification
tasks.description: Implement server-side, resumable, transactional queued dispatch for SYSTEM-executor steps at due_at - never a browser process (SN-SEQ-042). Immediately before sending, re-verify every precondition (SN-SEQ-043, AC-SEQ-043.1): not opted out, WhatsApp account CONNECTED, template still APPROVED, service-window state, credit balance, and that no break criterion has since been met - a failed precondition marks the step FAILED with a reason and writes a timeline event, it never silently skips. Implement rate limiting (SN-SEQ-044, AC-SEQ-044.1): respect the accounts throughput_mps (5/sec on Coexistence) and quiet hours, deferring quiet-hours-scheduled sends to the next permitted time rather than dropping them. Implement failure handling (SN-SEQ-045): 3 retries with exponential backoff for transient errors; permanent errors (invalid number, opt-out, template rejected) fail immediately with the reason, pausing the enrolment and notifying the owner rather than silently continuing to the next step.
acceptance_criteria: AC-SEQ-043.1
AC-SEQ-044.1

tasks.title: Backend logic: live-sequence edit propagation and per-sequence reporting rollups
tasks.description: Implement the live-edit-impact mechanism (SN-SEQ-051): editing a sequence with active enrolments must compute and show how many enrolments are affected and let the author choose Apply-to-new-enrolments-only (default - existing enrolments keep running the old definition) or Apply-to-all (existing enrolments adopt the change from their current position). Implement the pre-activation preview (SN-SEQ-052): the full timeline of what a lead enrolled today would receive and when, rendered against a sample lead with tokens resolved. Implement per-sequence reporting rollups (F08 section 7): enrolled/active/completed/broken-by-reason counts, per-step completion and drop-off rate, content-view rate per step, median time to completion, and conversion rate of enrolled leads to a terminal WON stage.
acceptance_criteria: Choosing Apply-to-new-enrolments-only after an edit leaves every currently-active enrolments next dispatch unchanged from its pre-edit definition.

tasks.title: Frontend: sequence builder - step list, break criteria, preview, lifecycle state
tasks.description: Build the sequence builder consuming the SEQ-002 contract: a vertical step list with relative-move drag reordering (posting position AFTER plus relative_to, never a full index array, SN-SEQ-050), delay steps rendered between numbered steps using display_number=0 (SN-SEQ-010), editors for the four action types (SHARE_CONTENT, CONTACT_LEAD with free-text instructions, DELAY, SEND_WHATSAPP_TEMPLATE) each showing its executor (USER/SYSTEM) badge (SN-SEQ-001/011), a break-criteria configuration panel defaulting on_inbound_message and terminal-stage breaks to ON (SN-SEQ-020), a pre-activation preview showing the full resolved-token timeline against a sample lead (SN-SEQ-052), and DRAFT/ACTIVE/PAUSED/ARCHIVED lifecycle controls with PAUSED as a first-class, non-destructive action (SN-SEQ-053).
acceptance_criteria: Pausing a sequence halts all dispatch without breaking any enrolment, and resuming continues from where it left off.

tasks.title: Frontend: enrolment UI - manual, bulk with preview, re-enrolment, removal
tasks.description: Build enrolment UI consuming the SEQ-002 contract: manual enrol action from lead detail; bulk enrol from a list/filter view showing the /preview breakdown (eligible / already enrolled / opted out / terminal stage / estimated cost, SN-SEQ-031) before confirming; an explicit re-enrolment confirmation dialog for leads who already completed the sequence (SN-SEQ-032); and a removal action that clearly states pending steps will be cancelled while history is kept (SN-SEQ-033).
acceptance_criteria: Re-enrolling a completed lead always requires an explicit confirming click; there is no path that auto-re-enrols.

tasks.title: Frontend: My Tasks queue UI
tasks.description: Build the /my-tasks screen consuming the SEQ-002 contract: tasks grouped by due date visually consistent with and cross-linked to /follow-ups but kept as a separate list (SN-SEQ-040), each task showing lead/step/instructions and a one-tap action (open WhatsApp pre-filled, or share content), and Complete/Skip(with required reason)/Snooze controls per task (SN-SEQ-041), with Skip always available regardless of step type.
acceptance_criteria: Every task exposes a visible Skip control regardless of action type.

tasks.title: Frontend: live-edit impact dialog and per-sequence reporting dashboard
tasks.description: Build the this-sequence-has-N-active-enrolments impact dialog shown on editing a live sequence, offering the Apply-to-new-only (default) vs Apply-to-all choice with the affected count visible (SN-SEQ-051). Build the per-sequence reporting dashboard: enrolled/active/completed/broken-by-reason funnel, per-step completion and drop-off chart, content-view rate per step, median completion time, and conversion rate to a terminal WON stage (F08 section 7).
acceptance_criteria: The impact dialog blocks silent application of an edit to running enrolments - a choice must be made explicitly.

tasks.title: Integration: wire sequence builder/enrolment/tasks/reporting to live backend
tasks.description: Replace mocks in the sequence builder, enrolment flows, My Tasks queue, and reporting dashboard with the live SEQ backend. Verify AUTOMATED/MIXED sequence creation is correctly blocked/unblocked based on a real connected WhatsApp account status from F12, that SYSTEM-step dispatch precondition re-checks behave correctly against a real disconnected-account scenario, and that break criteria correctly halt dispatch end to end when a real inbound message or opt-out event arrives.
acceptance_criteria: No sequence screen calls a mock/stub endpoint.
A step scheduled against a since-disconnected account fails end to end with WA_NOT_CONNECTED and a visible timeline event.

tasks.title: QA: verify sequence acceptance criteria
tasks.description: Execute and record pass/fail for every acceptance criterion in F08-sequences.md against the integrated (SEQ-013) system: an inbound WhatsApp message breaks an enrolment before its next step dispatches; an opt-out breaks all three of a leads active enrolments within 60s; a step scheduled 3 days ago against a now-disconnected account fails with WA_NOT_CONNECTED and a timeline event; a step due inside quiet hours dispatches at the next permitted time rather than being dropped.
acceptance_criteria: AC-SEQ-020.1
AC-SEQ-023.1
AC-SEQ-043.1
AC-SEQ-044.1

tasks.title: Schema: rules, execution/distribution logs, round-robin state, and CAPI per-lead fields
tasks.description: Create migrations/models per F09 sections 2/7: rules table (rule_kind enum ROUTING|DISTRIBUTION, priority integer, is_default boolean, conditions JSONB storing flat three-part tuples with denormalised display_value/field_label captured at authoring time per SN-RULE-004, actions JSONB shaped per SN-RULE-020/030). Create rule_execution_log (rule_id, lead_id, matched boolean, conditions_evaluated JSONB, actions_taken JSONB, errors, duration_ms) retained per plan tier (7/30/90 days). Create distribution_log (rule_id, lead_id, recipient, channel, status, error, cost) queryable/exportable (SN-RULE-033). Create round_robin_state per rule tracking whose turn is next, count received this round, and last-received timestamp per member (SN-RULE-022), skippable without consuming a turn for deactivated/unavailable members (SN-RULE-023). Add per-lead CAPI columns: fb_conversion_event, fb_conversion_sent_at, can_send_conversion_event, with dedup on event_id (SN-RULE-051).
acceptance_criteria: round_robin_state persists per-member last-received timestamp and current-round count queryable independently of the rule_execution_log.

tasks.title: Contract: rule CRUD, relative move, fields/values vocabulary, test, and CAPI config endpoints
tasks.description: Define routes/requests/policies/generated types (SN-ARCH-032) for: rule CRUD (routing and distribution as one rule_kind-differentiated resource per F09 section 1); GET /api/v1/rules/fields and POST /api/v1/rules/fields/{key}/values (server-supplied dynamic vocabulary including specific keys within source_payload for the selected source, SN-RULE-003); POST /api/v1/rules/{id}/move accepting move UP or position AFTER plus relative_to - never a full array (SN-RULE-011); POST /api/v1/rules/{id}/test accepting a lead_id or sample_payload, returning match result, failing condition, and would-run actions without executing them (SN-RULE-013); and Meta CAPI stage-to-event mapping config endpoints per connected ad account (SN-RULE-050). Validation must name the specific field and row on failure.
acceptance_criteria: The test endpoints response schema includes matched/failing-condition/would-run-actions and the endpoint performs zero side effects, verified by a contract test.

tasks.title: Backend logic: condition engine and dynamic field/value vocabulary
tasks.description: Implement the flat condition engine (SN-RULE-001): three-part field to operator to value tuples combined with a single AND/OR across the whole rule, one nesting level, no condition trees. Implement the five operators (SN-RULE-002): EQUALS, NOT_EQUALS, CONTAINS, STARTS_WITH, ENDS_WITH. Implement the server-supplied field/value vocabulary (SN-RULE-003) backing the RULE-002 endpoints - fields include lead attributes, custom fields, source, integration, form, and specific keys within source_payload for the selected source, all derived from the orgs actual data, never hardcoded per source. Capture display_value and field_label at authoring time alongside the raw value so a rule still reads correctly after the underlying entity (e.g. a Facebook form) is renamed (SN-RULE-004). Implement row-specific validation messages naming the exact field and row (SN-RULE-005).
acceptance_criteria: Renaming a Facebook form after a rule references it leaves the rules displayed condition text unchanged (reads from the captured display_value, not a live join).

tasks.title: Backend logic: synchronous priority-ordered evaluation pipeline with execution logging
tasks.description: Implement priority-ordered, first-match-wins evaluation (SN-RULE-010, AC-RULE-010.1): rules evaluate in priority order, the first matchs actions execute and evaluation stops; an is_default rule may exist as an always-matching final fallback. Implement synchronous evaluation inside the lead-ingest path, completing before the lead-created notification fires so the lead is already assigned when the rep is notified (SN-RULE-012, AC-RULE-012.1), budgeted at under 50ms p95. Implement relative-move reordering via the RULE-002 endpoint (SN-RULE-011). Implement the test-without-execute path (SN-RULE-013, AC-RULE-013.1) including the live N-of-your-last-500-leads-would-have-matched count. Write a rule_execution_log row for every evaluation - rule, lead, matched, conditions evaluated, actions taken, errors, duration - retained per the plans retention window and visible per-rule in the UI (SN-RULE-014).
acceptance_criteria: AC-RULE-010.1
AC-RULE-012.1
AC-RULE-013.1

tasks.title: Backend logic: routing actions - assign, groups, fields, notify, weighted round-robin
tasks.description: Implement the routing action set (SN-RULE-020): assign (list of membership_id+weight+per-assignee sequence_id so different team members receive different follow-up sequences from the same rule, SN-RULE-021), add_to_groups, set_fields, notify (ASSIGNEE/MANAGER). Implement weighted round-robin distribution within a rule (SN-RULE-022, AC-RULE-022.1): state is per-rule and UI-visible (whose turn is next, how many each received this round, when each last received a lead). Implement availability-aware skipping (SN-RULE-023): a DEACTIVATED member or one who has set themselves unavailable is skipped in rotation without consuming their turn. Where assign includes a sequence_id, enrol the lead via the SEQ-004 enrolment engine.
acceptance_criteria: AC-RULE-022.1

tasks.title: Backend logic: distribution actions - broadcast/round-robin, recipients, costing, log
tasks.description: Implement distribution modes (SN-RULE-030): BROADCAST (every matching lead to all recipients) and ROUND_ROBIN (leads cycle one at a time) - spelled correctly in every constant, contract and export. Implement recipients that need not be org members (SN-RULE-031): email, WhatsApp number, in-app member, webhook URL. Implement save_to_account (SN-RULE-032): controls whether a forwarded lead is also saved into the senders account or only forwarded. Write full dispatch history to distribution_log - rule, lead, recipient, channel, status, error, cost - queryable and exportable (SN-RULE-033). Implement WhatsApp-distribution credit costing with an estimated-monthly-cost preview from recent volume and a low-balance warning shown before sends start failing (SN-RULE-034).
acceptance_criteria: The persisted/serialized distribution-mode constant is spelled ROUND_ROBIN, never a misspelling, across schema, API and export.

tasks.title: Backend logic: WhatsApp auto-responder composition and precondition checks
tasks.description: Implement the auto-responder as a composition, not a separate subsystem (SN-RULE-040): connected WhatsApp account + a routing rule + an AUTOMATED sequence, presented as one guided setup. Implement cheap existence-check probing of each of the three preconditions and, where a precondition is missing, return what is missing, why it is needed, and a direct link to fix it - never a disabled control with no explanation (SN-RULE-041).
acceptance_criteria: Each of the three preconditions can be independently probed and independently reports its own missing/present state with a fix-it link.

tasks.title: Backend logic: Meta Conversions API dispatch, PII hashing, and reporting
tasks.description: Implement server-side conversion-event dispatch to Meta when a lead reaches a configured stage, per connected ad account, configurable as which-stage-maps-to-which-event (SN-RULE-050). SHA-256 hash email and phone before transmission per Metas requirement - raw PII must never be sent (SN-RULE-052, AC-RULE-052.1). Implement per-lead event state and dedup (SN-RULE-051): fb_conversion_event, fb_conversion_sent_at, can_send_conversion_event, and dedup on event_id so a stage bounce does not double-count. Implement reporting (SN-RULE-053): events sent, match rate, per-campaign and per-adset attribution, 7/30-day windows.
acceptance_criteria: AC-RULE-052.1

tasks.title: Frontend: shared rule builder - dynamic conditions, priority, test panel
tasks.description: Build the rule builder UI shared by routing and distribution kinds, consuming the RULE-002 contract: a two-step dynamic field/operator/value picker fed live by the fields/values vocabulary endpoints (SN-RULE-003), flat AND/OR condition rows with row-specific validation errors naming the exact field and row (SN-RULE-005), relative priority reordering, an is_default fallback toggle, a live N-of-your-last-500-leads-would-match preview, and a test-against-a-specific-lead panel that clearly states no action was executed (SN-RULE-013).
acceptance_criteria: AC-RULE-013.1 reproduced client-side: running Test never triggers a real assignment, enrolment, or message.

tasks.title: Frontend: routing rule actions UI - assign, round-robin, groups/fields/notify
tasks.description: Build the routing-actions panel of the rule builder consuming RULE-002: multi-assignee assign control with weight and a per-assignee sequence picker (SN-RULE-021), a weighted round-robin configuration surfacing the UI-visible state from SN-RULE-022 (whose turn is next, counts this round, last-received timestamps), add_to_groups/set_fields/notify action builders, and a visible indicator when a member is being skipped in rotation due to deactivation/unavailability (SN-RULE-023).
acceptance_criteria: The round-robin panel shows whose turn is next and each members last-received timestamp without a page reload.

tasks.title: Frontend: distribution rule UI - mode, recipients, costing, log viewer
tasks.description: Build the distribution-rule UI consuming RULE-002: BROADCAST/ROUND_ROBIN mode picker (SN-RULE-030), recipient management supporting both org members and external addresses/webhooks (SN-RULE-031), a save_to_account toggle with plain-language explanation of both legitimate use cases (SN-RULE-032), an estimated-monthly-cost preview with low-balance warning (SN-RULE-034), and a distribution_log viewer with export (SN-RULE-033).
acceptance_criteria: The distribution log viewer supports exporting the currently filtered view.

tasks.title: Frontend: auto-responder guided setup and Meta CAPI configuration/reporting UI
tasks.description: Build the one-feature guided setup screen for the WhatsApp auto-responder (SN-RULE-040) that checks and displays the state of all three preconditions (connected WhatsApp account, routing rule, AUTOMATED sequence) with an explanation and direct fix-it link for whichever is missing, never a disabled button with no explanation (SN-RULE-041). Build the Meta CAPI configuration screen (stage-to-event mapping per connected ad account, SN-RULE-050) and its reporting dashboard (events sent, match rate, per-campaign/adset attribution, 7/30-day windows, SN-RULE-053).
acceptance_criteria: Every missing precondition state shows a reason and a working deep link to the screen that resolves it.

tasks.title: Frontend: rule execution log viewer
tasks.description: Build the per-rule execution log viewer consuming RULE-002/RULE-004: rule, lead, matched, conditions evaluated, actions taken, errors, duration, with the retention window displayed matching the orgs plan tier (7/30/90 days, SN-RULE-014).
acceptance_criteria: Why did this lead go to a specific rep is answerable by opening this log for the relevant rule in one click from the rule detail screen.

tasks.title: Integration: wire routing/distribution/auto-responder/CAPI frontend to live backend
tasks.description: Replace mocks across the rule builder, routing/distribution action panels, auto-responder setup, and CAPI screens with the live RULE backend. Verify the under-50ms p95 synchronous evaluation budget in the real lead-ingest path (hooking into F02s ingest pipeline), verify round-robin skip-without-consuming behaves correctly against real membership availability state from F14, and verify CAPI events reach Metas endpoint with hashed PII against a real connected ad account from F10.
acceptance_criteria: No rule/automation screen calls a mock/stub endpoint.
p95 evaluation latency measured in the real ingest path is under 50ms.

tasks.title: QA: verify automation acceptance criteria
tasks.description: Execute and record pass/fail for every acceptance criterion in F09-automation.md against the integrated (RULE-014) system: two matching rules at different priorities execute only the higher-priority one and log the other as not-evaluated; a webhook-arriving lead is already assigned when its notification is delivered; testing a rule against a lead triggers no assignment/enrolment/message; round-robin over 3 members with one deactivated splits 6 leads 3/3 between the two active members without consuming the deactivated members turn; a CAPI event for a lead with email and phone contains only SHA-256 hashes with no plaintext PII.
acceptance_criteria: AC-RULE-010.1
AC-RULE-012.1
AC-RULE-013.1
AC-RULE-022.1
AC-RULE-052.1

tasks.title: Create integration registry, connection and inbound_event schema
tasks.description: Create Postgres migrations and Eloquent models for: (1) integration_registry (key, name, description, icon_url, category enum LEAD_SOURCE/AUTOMATION/IMPORT_EXPORT/OTHER, auth_type enum OAUTH/API_KEY/TOKEN/WEBHOOK/EMAIL/NONE, visibility enum PUBLIC/BETA/STAFF_ONLY/UPCOMING, parser_key, config_schema jsonb, setup_url, help_url); (2) integration_connection (tenant-scoped, references registry, status enum CONNECTED/NOT_CONNECTED/EXPIRING_SOON/EXPIRED/ERROR, per-account credentials/token, health fields: last_success_at, error_count, last_error, token_expires_at); (3) inbound_event (raw payload jsonb, provider event id for idempotency, status enum RECEIVED/PROCESSING/PROCESSED/FAILED, retention window, tenant-scoped). All tenant-scoped tables MUST use the org global scope pattern per SN-SEC-003. Add unique constraint on (registry_key, provider_event_id) for idempotency, and indexes supporting health queries.
acceptance_criteria: Migrations create integration_registry, integration_connection, inbound_event with the fields and enums listed
A unique constraint prevents two inbound_event rows for the same provider event id per connection
All three tables carry org_id and are excluded by default from cross-tenant queries

tasks.title: Define integrations API contract, requests, policies and generated types
tasks.description: Implement route/request/response contract: GET /api/v1/integrations (server-declared list per SN-INTG-001, rendered from integration_registry filtered by visibility), POST/DELETE /api/v1/integrations/{key}/connections, GET /api/v1/integrations/{key}/connections (status), GET /api/v1/integrations/connections/{id}/health, POST /api/v1/inbound-events/{id}/replay and bulk replay (staff-only policy). Define FormRequest validation classes, Policy classes gating replay to staff and connection management to capability holders, and generate the OpenAPI spec + typed TS client per SN-ARCH-032.
acceptance_criteria: GET /api/v1/integrations returns registry rows filtered by visibility with zero hardcoded integration names in the response schema
Generated TypeScript types are published for frontend consumption
Replay endpoint is policy-gated to staff capability

tasks.title: Implement the shared 9-step ingestion pipeline orchestrator
tasks.description: Implement the pipeline: persist raw payload to inbound_event before anything else, verify signature and reject unsigned/mismatched with 401, return 200 within 200ms p95 with parsing done asynchronously on a queued job, discard duplicates keyed on provider event id, mark FAILED with error detail on parser exceptions without ever returning 500, and preserve full campaign/adset/ad/form/question metadata in source_payload. Every pipeline stage MUST emit an event-log entry with correlation/causation ids per SN-AI-010, and async processing MUST run on Horizon queues per SN-ARCH-011. This orchestrator is source-agnostic; specific parsers plug in via parser_key.
acceptance_criteria: AC-INTG-011.1
AC-INTG-013.1
AC-INTG-014.1

tasks.title: Implement Facebook/Instagram Lead Ads connection lifecycle and token expiry handling
tasks.description: Implement the Facebook/Instagram Lead Ads integration: OAuth connection with Account to Pages to Forms hierarchy where each form is independently enabled/disabled with bulk enable-all/disable-all per page; proactive token expiry detection showing EXPIRING_SOON from 7 days out, email+in-app notification at 7/3/1 days, one-click renewal, and queuing failed deliveries for replay after renewal; partial-failure connection where connecting 5 pages with 2 failures connects the 3 successful ones and reports the 2 failures with reasons.
acceptance_criteria: Connecting 5 pages where 2 fail leaves 3 connected and returns per-page failure reasons
A connection at 7 days from token expiry shows EXPIRING_SOON and triggers the day-7 notification
Renewing an expired token replays queued failed deliveries

tasks.title: Implement Facebook backfill, delayed-delivery detection and auto-tagging
tasks.description: On connection, offer historical backfill of leads from the last 30/90 days, marking backfilled leads is_backfill=true so they do not trigger alerts, rules or sequences and do not distort response-time metrics; compare Meta's created_time against receipt time and raise a dismissible warning when the gap exceeds 15 minutes; support auto-adding leads to groups by page/campaign/form, configured per connection, implemented as rules in the F09 automation engine rather than a bolted-on preference.
acceptance_criteria: A backfill import creates leads with is_backfill=true and fires zero alerts/rules/sequence enrolments
A page with leads arriving more than 15 min after Meta's created_time shows a delayed-delivery warning

tasks.title: Implement remaining V1 integration parsers (WordPress, generic webhook, Zapier, LinkedIn, Google, TikTok)
tasks.description: Implement parser_key handlers: WordPress token-based connection supporting Contact Form 7, WPForms, Elementor, Gravity Forms, Ninja Forms, Forminator, Divi, Fluent Forms, Houzez, with setup that polls connection status and confirms in-app the moment the first payload arrives; a generic webhook integration with per-connection URL+secret, documented JSON contract, field-mapping configuration, and a send-test-payload preview action; seed registry rows and parsers for Zapier, LinkedIn Lead Gen Forms, Google Forms/Ads, TikTok Lead Ads (99acres/MagicBricks deferred to G4 evaluation).

acceptance_criteria: Reusing a rotated refresh token revokes every token in its family
Revoking a family invalidates the associated Sanctum access tokens immediately, verified by an authenticated request failing right after revocation
6th OTP attempt or use after single-use is rejected

tasks.title: Implement layered rate-limiting middleware
tasks.description: Implement the full rate-limit table (SN-SEC-008): 60 req/min unauthenticated per IP, OTP generation 3/identifier/15min + 10/IP/hour, 600 req/min per authenticated membership, public lead-form submit 5/IP/min + Turnstile, share-viewer tracking 1 report/10s/session, bulk operations 10/member/hour, exports 1/member/hour + 3/org/hour, public API per-plan published in response headers.
