Rate limiting MUST NOT be implemented inside controllers. Where the bible's illustrative defaults (60/min api, 10/min auth) disagree with the SN-SEC-008 table, SN-SEC-008 wins - it is the project-specific requirement.
acceptance_criteria: Each row of the SN-SEC-008 table has an enforced, independently-testable named limiter registered in a service provider
No rate-limiting logic exists inside any controller, verified by review or static check
Public API responses carry rate-limit headers reflecting the caller's plan

tasks.title: Implement column-level encryption and KMS integration for sensitive columns
tasks.description: Implement TLS 1.3 + HSTS preload at the edge, AES-256 at rest for DB/object storage (infra config), and column-level encryption for integration credentials, OAuth tokens and WhatsApp session data, keyed in a managed KMS with annual key rotation (SN-SEC-004). Provide an encrypted-cast Eloquent attribute/service usable by any domain storing such secrets.
acceptance_criteria: Integration credential and WhatsApp session columns are unreadable via a raw DB dump without the KMS key
Key rotation runs annually without requiring re-encryption downtime

tasks.title: Stand up secrets management and commit-time secret scanning
tasks.description: Configure a managed secret manager for all environments (no secrets in code, images, .env files in VCS, logs, or error messages) and enable secret-scanning on every commit that blocks the merge on detection (SN-SEC-005). Document the rotate-immediately-on-exposure procedure.
acceptance_criteria: A test commit containing a fake secret is blocked by CI before merge
Secret manager holds all runtime secrets; no plaintext secret exists in the repo

tasks.title: Implement request/webhook input validation framework and anti-SQLi static gate
tasks.description: Provide a shared schema-validation layer (FormRequest/rule-objects) enforced on every request body, query parameter and webhook payload that rejects unknown fields rather than ignoring them (SN-SEC-006). Add a static-analysis CI gate that fails on any string-concatenated SQL.
acceptance_criteria: A request with an undeclared extra field is rejected with a 422, not silently dropped
CI fails on a deliberately introduced string-concatenated query in a test PR

tasks.title: Implement output-safety sanitizer and CSP policies
tasks.description: Implement server-side sanitisation of user-supplied page content against an allowlist at write time (not read time), require review + sanitiser wrapper for any dangerouslySetInnerHTML usage, and configure strict CSP (no inline script, no eval, explicit allowlist) for the public surface plus a documented, shrinking CSP exception list for the authenticated app (SN-SEC-007).
acceptance_criteria: A malicious script tag submitted as page content is stripped before storage
Public-surface CSP report-only/enforced header contains no inline-script or eval allowance

tasks.title: Implement webhook signature verification and replay-protection library
tasks.description: Build a reusable webhook-security library implementing signature verification before any other processing, replay protection via timestamp window plus event-id dedup, and the rule that an unverified payload is persisted (for debugging/signal) and rejected, never processed (SN-SEC-009).
acceptance_criteria: A payload with an invalid signature is persisted-and-rejected, never handed to business logic
A replayed event-id within the window is deduplicated and not reprocessed

tasks.title: Implement file-upload security pipeline
tasks.description: Implement upload handling (SN-SEC-006): verify content-type against actual file bytes (not just extension), enforce an extension allowlist, enforce size limits at the signing step, and serve non-renderable types from a separate origin with Content-Disposition: attachment.
acceptance_criteria: A file renamed to a disguised extension with mismatched magic bytes is rejected
Non-renderable uploads download with Content-Disposition: attachment from the asset origin, not the app origin

tasks.title: Harden the public surface: opaque identifiers and data-minimisation posture
tasks.description: Ensure share-viewer and lead-form public identifiers are opaque, non-sequential (e.g. ULID/UUID), scoped, and unguessable (SN-SEC-015). Verify the public deployment carries no CRM code and no third-party analytics/scripts (SN-PRIV-001). This is a hardening pass over the F07 share viewer and F11 lead form public deployments.
acceptance_criteria: No sequential integer ID is ever exposed in a public share or form URL or response body
Public bundle contains zero third-party analytics/tracking scripts, verified by network-request audit

tasks.title: Set up dependency vulnerability scanning and per-release SBOM generation
tasks.description: Configure automated dependency vulnerability scanning on every build with criticals patched within 48h and highs within 7 days, committed lockfiles, reviewed dependency additions, and an SBOM generated per release (SN-SEC-012).
acceptance_criteria: A build with a known-critical vulnerable dependency fails or is flagged for 48h remediation tracking
Each release artifact has an attached SBOM

tasks.title: Build owner-facing audit-log and security-settings UI
tasks.description: Build the settings-area screen that lists audit_log entries with filters (action, actor, date range) and pagination, per SN-SEC-010's owner-visible-in-settings requirement. Build against the SEC-02 generated contract/types only - no direct backend logic dependency.
acceptance_criteria: Owner can filter the audit log by action type, actor and date range
Non-owner memberships cannot reach this screen (route-guarded)

tasks.title: Integrate audit-log viewer and bulk-export controls end to end
tasks.description: Wire the SEC-16 frontend audit-log viewer and the bulk-export audit/rate-limit/notify flow (now consolidated under TASK-DATA-013 and TASK-DATA-014) to the real backend (SEC-03, SEC-04, SEC-06), replacing any mock data, and verify the full round trip: an action occurs, an audit_log row appears, the viewer displays it with correct filtering.
acceptance_criteria: A live permission change appears in the owner's audit-log viewer within the page's normal refresh/poll interval
No mock/stub data remains in the audit-log viewer component

tasks.title: Verify security control suite against section-3 acceptance bar
tasks.description: Verify authentication, authorization, tenant isolation, encryption, secrets, input/output validation, rate limiting, webhook security, audit logging, bulk-export controls, dependency scanning and public-surface hardening implemented in SEC-01 through SEC-17 against every requirement in 10-nfr-security-compliance.md section 3 (SN-SEC-001 through SN-SEC-015) and the reasonable-security-safeguards obligation (SN-COMP-006).
acceptance_criteria: Every SN-SEC-00x requirement has a passing automated or documented manual check
No cross-tenant leak reproducible in manual pen-test-style spot checks

tasks.title: Create schema for consent, data-subject-request and retention tracking
tasks.description: Create migrations/models for consent_record (organization_id, lead_id/source, notice_version, ip, captured_at, guardian_consent boolean nullable, SN-COMP-001/005), data_subject_request (organization_id, requester_identifier, type: ACCESS|CORRECT|ERASE, status, resolved_at, SN-COMP-003, SN-PRIV-005, SN-DATA-023), and retention_job_run (data_class, run_at, records_purged, SN-PRIV-004).
acceptance_criteria: consent_record captures notice_version, ip and timestamp on every insert
data_subject_request supports all three request types with a status lifecycle

tasks.title: Define consent-capture and data-subject-request API contract
tasks.description: Define routes, FormRequest validation and policy scaffolding for: consent capture on public lead-form submission (records notice_version/ip/timestamp), and an internal data-subject-request search-by-identifier/correct/erase workflow across all entity types (SN-COMP-001/003, SN-DATA-023, SN-PRIV-005). acceptance_criteria: Generated typed client includes consent-capture and DSR search/correct/erase operations
Cross-tenant DSR lookup returns 404, not the other org's record

tasks.title: Implement cross-entity identifier search, correction and erasure for data-subject requests (incl. individual lead erasure)
tasks.description: Implement the ability to find every record for a given phone number or email across all entity types (leads, timeline events, WhatsApp messages, content views) and correct or erase it (SN-COMP-003, SN-DATA-023). Erasure removes the record from customer-visible surfaces while preserving audit-log evidence of the erasure action itself
Erasing a lead removes its identifiable PII while aggregate reporting totals remain unchanged
The erased lead cannot be un-erased (irreversible by design)

tasks.title: Implement consent capture on public lead forms with guardian-consent field configuration
tasks.description: Implement configurable consent-notice capture on public lead forms recording timestamp, notice version and IP with the submission, in English and Hindi at minimum (SN-COMP-001). A form can be configured to require a guardian-consent field before accepting a minor's data
A submission with consent checked stores consent=true and a timestamp on the created lead record, with a link to the org privacy policy shown alongside the checkbox

tasks.title: Implement WhatsApp opt-out registry enforced across every send path
tasks.description: Implement an opt-out registry keyed by phone number + organization that is checked and honoured instantly on every WhatsApp send path (campaigns, sequences, manual), per SN-COMP-002 and DPDP's withdrawal-as-easy-as-consent principle. Opt-out takes effect in under the same request/response cycle that recorded it

tasks.title: Implement scheduled data-retention enforcement jobs
tasks.description: Implement scheduled, monitored jobs enforcing every row of the retention table (SN-PRIV-004): leads/activity (life + 90 days), raw webhook payloads (90 days), raw parsed emails (90 days), WhatsApp message content (life of account), audit log (2 years), access logs (90 days), export files (24h), import files (7 days), deleted-account data (30-day grace then purge, backups <=35 days), invoices (8 years). acceptance_criteria: Each retention class has a scheduled job with a monitored run recorded in retention_job_run
A file older than its retention window is verifiably purged on the next scheduled run

tasks.title: Implement breach-impact determination tool
tasks.description: Implement an internal tool/query capability to quickly and accurately determine which records were affected by a security incident and which organisations they belong to (SN-COMP-004, and the 72-hour GDPR breach-notification clock, SN-COMP-013). tasks.title: Build data-subject-rights search and consent-management UI

tasks.title: Verify DPDP and GDPR data-subject-rights and consent compliance

acceptance_criteria: A lead deleted at the Meta source is removed from any cache within the permitted window
No export generated after the permitted window contains the deleted lead

tasks.title: Scope and document Google API Services Limited Use compliance

Limited Use disclosure document exists and is linked from the integration's settings screen

tasks.title: Implement payment compliance posture: PCI SAQ-A, RBI pre-debit notice, GST invoicing
tasks.description: Ensure card data never touches our infrastructure (PCI-DSS SAQ-A only, delegated to the payment provider's hosted fields/checkout), implement RBI-mandated pre-debit notification for Indian recurring payments, and GST-compliant invoicing (SN-COMP-024, SN-BILL-024). tasks.title: Pin India-primary-region data localisation

A documented checklist exists and is required before any new region/sub-processor is added

Retest confirms remediation before launch sign-off

tasks.title: Define internal event-log write and query API contract

Every emitted event carries a non-null organization_id

tasks.title: Implement graceful AI degradation and org-level AI off-switch

Toggling org AI off hides/disables all AI entry points without breaking any non-AI flow

tasks.title: Design tenant-scoped retrieval index filtering (V2 prep)

tasks.title: Implement AI governance guardrails: no-training, minimisation, confirmation gate, uncertainty surfacing
tasks.description: Implement the governance rules: customer data must never be used to train/fine-tune any model without explicit, separately-obtained, revocable opt-in consent, and only zero-retention/no-training provider tiers are used (SN-AI-040); minimise context sent to the model, redacting identifiers that add nothing to the task, never sending payment data/credentials/full contact databases (SN-AI-041); AI may draft/suggest/rank/summarise/extract freely but MUST require explicit per-instance human confirmation before sending a customer message, changing a lead owner, deleting anything, making a purchase/consuming credits, or changing a permission/setting - the rep stays the author (SN-AI-003, SN-AI-042); low-confidence extractions are held for review, never written silently (SN-AI-043).

tasks.title: Implement per-tenant AI cost controls and usage caps

tasks.title: Implement AI sequence-generation draft capability

tasks.title: Build AI settings, governance and cost-dashboard UI

tasks.title: Build AI-assisted review and drafting UI surfaces

tasks.title: Implement graceful, honest degradation under load
tasks.description: Implement the degradation order (SN-NFR-005): under load, analytics rollups defer first, then bulk operations queue, then exports queue - ingestion and sending never degrade. Surface degraded state honestly in the UI rather than showing a silently stale dashboard. Also respects the event-path latency budgets in SN-NFR-003 (webhook received->200 <200ms; lead ingested->notification <5s p95/<10s p99; inbound WhatsApp->visible in app <5s; content viewed->alert <10s; rule evaluation in ingest path <50ms).
acceptance_criteria: Under simulated load, analytics rollups defer before ingestion is ever affected
A degraded dashboard displays an explicit 'data may be stale' indicator rather than silently serving stale numbers

tasks.title: Enforce non-2xx-on-failure webhook ingestion guarantee
tasks.description: Audit and enforce across every ingestion endpoint that a non-2xx status is returned on any failure to persist a payload, and that 200 is never returned for a payload that failed to persist (SN-NFR-011). Described as the single most damaging bug class available in the codebase because it converts a recoverable outage into permanent, silent, unattributable data loss.
acceptance_criteria: A forced persistence failure in a test environment causes the endpoint to return a non-2xx status
No code path exists that returns 200 before persistence is confirmed

tasks.title: Write incident runbooks and launch the public status page
tasks.description: Write incident-response runbooks for four scenarios: ingestion failure, WhatsApp mass disconnection, payment-provider outage, database failover. Stand up a public status page live from launch, and implement the SEV1/SEV2/SEV3 ack and comms cadence (SN-NFR-013: SEV1 15min ack + status page immediately/hourly; SEV2 30min ack + status page/4-hourly; SEV3 4h ack, in-app if user-visible), including published post-incident reviews for SEV1/SEV2.
acceptance_criteria: All four named runbooks exist and have been walked through in a tabletop exercise
Status page is live and a test SEV2 incident is posted within its 30-minute ack window

tasks.title: Run WCAG 2.1 AA accessibility audit and remediate
tasks.description: Audit and remediate all ten flows in 08-ux-flows.md to WCAG 2.1 AA, with AAA for body text (SN-NFR-020). Include keyboard navigability, visible focus, screen-reader testing on NVDA and VoiceOver, automated axe checks in CI plus manual review of each new flow, and verification that colour is never the sole carrier of meaning (stage/health badge colour coding). The public surface (share viewer, lead forms) is held to the same standard.
acceptance_criteria: Automated axe checks pass in CI for all ten flows, including the public surface
A screen-reader walkthrough on NVDA and VoiceOver completes each flow without a blocking defect

tasks.title: Implement internationalisation scaffolding for English-at-launch, structured for more
tasks.description: Externalise all user-facing strings from day one (SN-NFR-030). Implement E.164 phone handling with local display formatting, per-member timezones (ties to F04 follow-ups), locale-aware dates in the UI with ISO-8601 in every API response, INR and USD formatting, and ensure the font stack is Devanagari-capable ahead of the planned Hindi/Bahasa/Vietnamese rollout.
acceptance_criteria: No user-facing string is hard-coded outside the externalised strings catalogue
Every API response date/time field is ISO-8601; every UI date display honours the viewing member's locale/timezone

tasks.title: Verify the full operational-readiness launch-gate checklist
tasks.description: Verify every item in 10-nfr-security-compliance.md section 10 'Operational readiness - launch gate' is complete: tenant isolation suite green, pen test complete with criticals/highs remediated, load test at 2x passed, restore drill executed and timed, monitoring/alerting live for every SN-ARCH-052 metric, incident runbooks written, status page live, legal review of sections 5-7 complete, DPA/privacy-policy/ToS published, security.txt published, retention jobs verified, PII redaction verified against real logs, accessibility audit passed on all ten flows, performance budgets enforced and passing in CI. The single gate all other SEC/AI/HARDEN tasks feed into before V1 launch.
acceptance_criteria: Every checkbox in section 10 is independently verifiable and ticked with evidence
No item is marked done without a linked artifact (report, dashboard, recording)

tasks.title: Resolve WhatsApp provider decision (BSP vs direct Meta Tech Provider)
tasks.description: Resolve OD-1 before G3 implementation begins: obtain written confirmation of Coexistence support from 2-3 candidate BSPs, their per-message and platform pricing for India, their webhook completeness across all four streams including smb_message_echoes, and their India data-residency position. Recommendation is to start on a BSP that demonstrably supports Coexistence today and evaluate direct registration once volume makes the markup material. Since the WhatsAppChannelProvider port is specified with 12 methods and no vendor concepts above it, both options must implement the same interface, so this decision does not block port design, only the concrete adapter choice.
acceptance_criteria: Written Coexistence-support confirmation is on file from at least 2 candidate BSPs
A provider is selected and documented as an ADR before G3 implementation begins

tasks.title: Complete legal review of DPDP, GDPR and platform policy; publish DPA/policy/ToS
tasks.description: Resolve OD-4: engage external counsel before G2 to confirm or correct the working understanding of consent capture on lead forms, children's-data handling for education customers, breach-notification timelines (SN-COMP-013's 72-hour clock and the DPDP timeline), cross-border transfer for SEA, and the pre-launch/pre-V2-AI-feature DPIA requirement (SN-COMP-014). Document the lawful-basis-per-processing-activity Record of Processing Activities (SN-COMP-010). Publish the DPA, privacy policy and terms of service before launch.
acceptance_criteria: Counsel has signed off on sections 5-7 in writing before launch
DPA, privacy policy and terms of service are published and linked from the product before launch

tasks.title: Select hosting and managed services; provision India primary region
tasks.description: Resolve OD-10: select cloud provider, managed Postgres, managed Redis, object storage and CDN, constrained by an India primary region requirement (SN-ARCH-070), S3-compatible storage, PITR support, and good India/SEA CDN presence. Provision the environments. Document the second-region design placeholder (SN-ARCH-071, OD-11) as additive-only via organization.region, triggered only by real regulatory need or material SEA latency complaints, not anticipation.
acceptance_criteria: Production environment is provisioned in an India primary region with PITR-capable managed Postgres
organization.region column exists and defaults correctly without any second-region infrastructure being built

tasks.title: Implement shared dataviz/chart component set
tasks.description: Implement the shared chart/dataviz primitives referenced by every analytics-adjacent domain (bar, line, funnel/drop-off, and simple comparison charts) as a component family alongside the rest of the foundation library, following 07-design-system.md token/theming conventions. Consumers (ANL overview/lead/WhatsApp dashboards, RULE Meta CAPI reporting, SEQ live-edit reporting dashboard, TEAM dashboard, CAMP monitoring/analytics) depend on this rather than hand-rolling charts per domain.
acceptance_criteria: Bar, line and funnel/drop-off chart components are documented in Storybook with theme-aware (light/dark) rendering
Charts meet the same accessibility bar (colour-blind-safe palette, textual data-table fallback) as the rest of the component library
At least one consumer domain (ANL) integrates the chart components without any domain-specific charting library

tasks.title: Provision inbound email receiving infrastructure for lead-via-email ingestion
tasks.description: Provision an inbound email receiving service (SES/Postmark or equivalent) with sender-allowlist-aware webhook routing into the platform's ingestion endpoint, so TASK-INTG-007's lead-via-email ingestion has a real inbound transport to build against instead of assuming one exists.
acceptance_criteria: A test email sent to the provisioned address is delivered as a signed webhook to the ingestion endpoint within the configured SLA
Provider credentials are stored via the secrets-management pipeline (TASK-SEC-008), not hardcoded

tasks.title: Implement PII redaction at the structured logger
tasks.description: Implement a structured-logging middleware/formatter that redacts PII fields (phone, email, message body, free-text notes) from log payloads before they reach the append-only event log or any external log sink, per 10-nfr-security-compliance.md SN-SEC-010. This is the redaction primitive TASK-TL-001's event log schema is written against.
acceptance_criteria: A deliberately-logged payload containing a phone number, email and free-text note has all three fields redacted in the persisted log record
Redaction is applied at the logger layer so no call site can accidentally bypass it

tasks.title: Implement seat-limit enforcement and self-serve proration hooks
tasks.description: Split out of the original monolithic paywall-enforcement task: implement seat-count limit checks against the active plan and the self-serve prorated-increase entitlement hook that TASK-BILL-005 calls when a seat upgrade is purchased mid-cycle.
acceptance_criteria: Inviting a member past the plan's seat limit is blocked with a paywall-eligible error
A seat-count increase mid-cycle raises the effective limit immediately once TASK-BILL-005's proration confirms payment

tasks.title: Implement downgrade data-retention and scheduled member-deactivation lifecycle
tasks.description: Split out of the original monolithic paywall-enforcement task: implement the downgrade data-retention behaviour and the 14/7/3/1-day scheduled member-deactivation countdown when an org's active seat count exceeds its new plan's limit after a downgrade.
acceptance_criteria: Downgrading an org past its seat limit schedules member deactivation at the documented 14/7/3/1-day checkpoints
Data belonging to a deactivated member remains retained (not deleted) and is restorable if the member is reactivated before org deletion

tasks.title: Implement 9-state subscription-access matrix enforcement
tasks.description: Split out of the original monolithic paywall-enforcement task: implement the 9-state subscription-access matrix (trial/active/past_due/etc. per SN-BILL-012) that determines which capability-grid rows are gated versus available for each subscription state.
acceptance_criteria: Each of the 9 subscription states maps to a documented, testable set of allowed/blocked capabilities
A subscription-state transition (e.g. active -> past_due) re-evaluates access within the same request cycle, no stale cache window
